scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @laundralens/client" "npm run dev -w @laundralens/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @laundralens/server && npm run build -w @laundralens/client && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @laundralens/server && npm run typecheck -w @laundralens/client
